subject: *: move exhaustPhysicalPlan for lock/sort/topn into physicalop (#63790)
summary: Refactor: move LogicalSort/TopN/Lock physical-plan enumeration from `pkg/planner/core` into `pkg/planner/core/operator/physicalop`, and relocate related helper utilities (order-by property derivation, MatchItems, ExplainPartitionBy, DeriveLimitStats, GetStatsInfo/BuildPhysicalJoinSchema) with corresponding caller updates (incl. `pkg/session/session.go`). Reviewed moved logic and updated call paths; behavior appears unchanged and consistent with prior semantics. Scanned later history up to `upstream/master`; no remaining Blocker/High issue attributable to this commit.
